+            expected = 256 + prefix_merge_len
+            for value in merge_values[prefix_merge_len:]:
+                if value != expected:
+                    inverted_merges = dict(zip(merge_values[prefix_merge_len:], merge_keys[prefix_merge_len:]))
+                    break
+                expected += 1
+            else:
+                inverted_merges = None
+            lines = []
+            append = lines.append
+            vocab = self.vocab
+            for idx, token in zip(vocab_keys[prefix_len:], vocab_values[prefix_len:]):
+                # note: many tokens may be partial utf-8 sequences
+                # and cannot be decoded into valid strings. Here we're using
+                # errors='replace' to replace them with the replacement char �.
+                # this also means that we couldn't possibly use .vocab in load()
+                # because decoding in this way is a lossy operation!
+                # find the children of this token, if any
+                if inverted_merges is None:
+                    merge_pos = idx - 256
+                    if prefix_merge_len <= merge_pos < len(merge_keys):
+                        # if this token has children, render it nicely as a merge
+                        idx0, idx1 = merge_keys[merge_pos]
+                        append(render_vocab_line(idx, token, vocab[idx0], vocab[idx1]))
+                    else:
+                        # otherwise this is leaf token, just print it
+                        # (this should just be the first 256 tokens, the bytes)
+                        append(render_vocab_line(idx, token))
+                else:
+                    pair = inverted_merges.get(idx)
+                    if pair is not None:
+                        # if this token has children, render it nicely as a merge
+                        idx0, idx1 = pair
+                        append(render_vocab_line(idx, token, vocab[idx0], vocab[idx1]))
+                    else:
+                        # otherwise this is leaf token, just print it
+                        # (this should just be the first 256 tokens, the bytes)
+                        append(render_vocab_line(idx, token))
+
